standard_prerequisites.name: Colimit criterion for ind-smooth maps
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces to factoring every finitely presented A -> Lambda through a smooth algebra.

standard_prerequisites.name: Finite blowup sequence desingularizes
standard_prerequisites.use: After finitely many Neron blowups R -> A becomes smooth at p.

standard_prerequisites.name: Smoothness at the generic point of a separable domain map
standard_prerequisites.use: R -> A is smooth at q = (0) after replacing A by its image in Lambda.

core_obligations: By the when-colimit lemma it suffices to factor an arbitrary finitely presented A -> Lambda through a smooth R-algebra.
Replace A by its image in Lambda: A is a domain with fraction field inside that of Lambda, hence separable over the fraction field of R, so R -> A is smooth at q = (0).
The desingularization lemma makes R -> A smooth at p after finitely many affine Neron blowups.
Replace A by a localization at an element off p; then R -> A is smooth and A -> Lambda is the wanted factorization.
proof_roadmap: Factorization reduction; domain image and generic smoothness; finite blowup sequence; localization finish.
